    Theorem B (= Theorem 3.1) #

    C(D) has a triangulated embedding if and only if every projection lim D → D_i is surjective, if and only if C(D) has an algebraic realization. Necessity is theoremB_necessity. Sufficiency is Proposition 2.3 for J = I and W = lim D, the module of compatible families, since C_I is all of C(D).
